description: Central configuration of the TOMWare.M experimental infrastructure. Paths are relative to the TOMWare/ repository root unless noted. No experimental value is hardcoded in the scripts.

randomization.seed_note: null => planner generates a cryptographic seed and records it in randomization_seeds.csv; pass an integer to reproduce an exact order.

isolation.restore_unit_note: Snapshot reverted per block (sample+repetition). Conditions in the same block share the initial clean state; order is randomized inside the block.

vmware.note: Orchestrate on the HOST with experiment/scripts/host/Run-HostCampaign.ps1. Snapshot must contain C:\TOMWare already copied and samples extracted. Results are copied to the host before each revert.

host_orchestrator.note: Do not run the campaign from an interactive VM window alone. Malware that kills PowerShell or paints the desktop is reverted on the host every block.

pin_condition_probe.note: Tries pin.exe without -t. If that fails, PIN is marked invalid and EMPTY becomes the minimum Pin baseline; recorded in campaign.json.

module_counters.note: Optional TOMWare.M internal counters (dedicated knob). Off by default: they do not change normal behavior.
